parameters.help_en: The name of the task. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称。长度为1~64个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the software in the software library. You can call the [ListSoftwarelibSoftware](~~ListSoftwarelibSoftware~~) operation to obtain the value
parameters.name: software_id

parameters.help_en:
The operating system to which the task applies. Only a single value is supported. Valid values:
Windows: Windows
Mac(Apple): macOS on Apple silicon
Mac(Intel): macOS on Intel processors
parameters.help_zh:
任务适用的操作系统，仅支持单个取值。取值：
Windows：Windows系统。
Mac(Apple)：Apple芯片的macOS系统。
Mac(Intel)：Intel芯片的macOS系统
parameters.name: support_os

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode. Valid values:
Once: Executes the task immediately.
Schedule: Executes the task on a schedule
parameters.help_zh:
执行模式。取值：
Once：立即执行。
Schedule：定时执行
parameters.name: execute_mode

parameters.help_en: The scheduled execution parameters. The value is a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 调度执行参数，JSON格式字符串
parameters.name: execute_parameters

parameters.help_en:
The execution period of the task. The value is a JSON string. The validType field specifies the period type. Valid values:
Once: Executes the task once.
Interval: Executes the task at specified intervals.
Weekly: Executes the task on a weekly basis
parameters.help_zh:
任务执行周期，JSON格式字符串。其中validType表示周期类型，取值：
Once：单次执行。
Interval：按间隔执行。
Weekly：按周执行
parameters.name: execute_period

parameters.help_en:
The type of the target matched by the policy. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: all users
UserGroupNormal: specified user groups
DevTagNormal: specified devices
DeviceGroupNormal: specified device groups
DevTagAll: all devices
None: not configured
parameters.help_zh:
策略匹配目标类型。取值：
UserGroupAll：全部用户。
UserGroupNormal：指定用户组。
DevTagNormal：指定设备。
DeviceGroupNormal：指定设备组。
DevTagAll：全部设备。
None：暂不配置
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the user groups. Duplicate IDs are not allowed. This parameter is required and at least one ID must be specified when MatchMode is set to UserGroupNormal. If MatchMode is set to other values, this parameter is not allowed. Otherwise, the request is rejected. You can call the [ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~) operation to obtain the values
parameters.help_zh: 用户组ID集合，不允许重复。MatchMode为UserGroupNormal时必填且至少传入1个；MatchMode为其他取值时不允许传入，否则请求被拒绝。取值来源：[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~)
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the device groups. Duplicate IDs are not allowed. This parameter is required when MatchMode is set to DeviceGroupNormal. If MatchMode is set to other values, this parameter is not allowed. Otherwise, the request is rejected. You can call the [ListDeviceGroups](~~ListDeviceGroups~~) operation to obtain the values
parameters.help_zh: 设备组ID集合，不允许重复。MatchMode为DeviceGroupNormal时必填；MatchMode为其他取值时不允许传入，否则请求被拒绝。取值来源：[ListDeviceGroups](~~ListDeviceGroups~~)
parameters.name: device_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the terminal devices. Duplicate IDs are not allowed. A single ID can be up to 1,000 characters in length. This parameter is required when MatchMode is set to DevTagNormal. If MatchMode is set to other values, this parameter is not allowed. Otherwise, the request is rejected
parameters.help_zh: 终端设备ID集合，不允许重复，单个ID长度不超过1000个字符。MatchMode为DevTagNormal时必填；MatchMode为其他取值时不允许传入，否则请求被拒绝
parameters.name: dev_tags

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the task. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter takes effect only when ExpireMode is set to Expire
parameters.help_zh: 任务过期时间，毫秒级Unix时间戳。仅在ExpireMode为Expire时生效
parameters.name: gmt_expired

parameters.help_en: The number of retries after the task fails
parameters.help_zh: 任务失败后的重试次数
parameters.name: retry_times

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for task execution. Unit: seconds. For example, a value of 3600 indicates 1 hour
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行超时时间，单位：秒。例如取值3600表示1小时
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en:
The expiration type. Valid values:
Expire: The task expires at the time specified by GmtExpired.
Never: The task never expires
parameters.help_zh:
过期类型。取值：
Expire：在GmtExpired指定的时间过期。
Never：永不过期
parameters.name: expire_mode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the software version to be distributed. You can call the [ListSoftwarelibVersion](~~ListSoftwarelibVersion~~) operation to obtain the value
parameters.help_zh: 待分发的软件版本ID。取值来源：[ListSoftwarelibVersion](~~ListSoftwarelibVersion~~)
parameters.name: version_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:
server: a task issued from the console
client: a task initiated by the client
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。取值：
server：控制台下发的任务。
client：客户端发起的任务
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the software. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 软件名称。长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: software_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the administrator account used to execute the task in Windows. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: Windows系统下用于执行任务的管理员账号名称。长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: run_as_account

Task.description_en: The information about the created task

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，秒级Unix时间戳

Status.description_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:
enabled: The task is enabled.
disabled: The task is disabled.

The initial status of a task after creation is disabled
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：
enabled：开启。
disabled：关闭。

任务创建后初始状态为disabled

SupportOs.description_en:
The operating system to which the task applies. Valid values:
Windows: Windows
Mac(Apple): macOS on Apple silicon
Mac(Intel): macOS on Intel processors
SupportOs.description_zh:
任务适用的操作系统。取值：
Windows：Windows系统。
Mac(Apple)：Apple芯片的macOS系统。
Mac(Intel)：Intel芯片的macOS系统

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the task. You can use the task ID to query the execution result of the task
TaskId.description_zh: 任务ID，用于查询任务执行结果
